notes: Interposer letters = J10/J11 40-pin positions 1:1 (row1 +5V/GND, rows 2-18 letters, row19 GND/GND, row20 NC/NC).
J2 row order maps to letter pairs directly: (A|B)=OSI1|OSI0 ... (a|b)=DB15|DB14. DB pairs are (odd|even).
STBY must be HIGH for normal operation (module has internal pullup; drive 1 from FPGA is safe).
Hardware mode default: OS[2:0]=000, SER=0 (parallel), range via J1 jumper (+-10V 1LSB=305.18uV / +-5V 152.59uV), output 16-bit twos complement.
Official ALINX AN706 reference XDC (OS1=PIN3, OS0=PIN4, CONVST=PIN5, OS2=PIN6...) differs at SER/CONV/STBY/WR positions: AD7606C adds those pins; AN706 module is plain AD7606.
